description: Implement employee leave screens (LeaveOverviewScreen, ApplyLeaveScreen) with responsive UI, form validation, and BLoC integration following AttendanceScreen patterns
steps: Create lib/features/leaves/presentation/screens/leave_overview_screen.dart with BlocProvider setup like AttendanceScreen
Implement responsive layout showing leave balance cards (annual/sick/casual) with AppColors styling
Add leave history section using DataTable for desktop and ListView for mobile, following AttendanceScreen responsive patterns
Include floating action button or prominent button to navigate to apply leave screen
Build leave application form with AppDropdown for leave type, date pickers for start/end dates, and text field for reason
Implement form validation: end date >= start date, calculate days dynamically, check against available balance
Add submit button that calls LeaveBloc to submit request, with loading states and error handling
Style all components using AppColors and follow responsive design patterns from existing screens
acceptance_criteria: LeaveOverviewScreen displays balance cards and history with responsive layout (mobile/tablet/desktop)
ApplyLeaveScreen form validates input correctly and shows dynamic day calculations
Form prevents submission when insufficient balance and shows appropriate error messages
Both screens integrate properly with LeaveBloc and handle loading/error states
UI components use consistent AppColors and match the visual style of existing screens
verification: Run `flutter analyze lib/features/leaves/presentation/screens/` and verify no compilation errors
Test responsive behavior by resizing app window to verify mobile/tablet/desktop layouts
Verify form validation works correctly by testing various input combinations
Check that BLoC integration properly updates UI state during data loading and submission
